denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: May 30, 2022
Claim: Diagnostic mammogram, May 2022
Reason Code: CO-197

Benefits are not available for the above service. Prior authorization was required and was not
obtained. Please refer to Section 3.3 of your Certificate of Coverage.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days of this notice.
denial_reason: Prior authorization was required and was not obtained.

sub_claims.text: Prior authorization was required for the diagnostic mammogram service.
sub_claims.rationale: The insurer claims that prior authorization was required for the diagnostic mammogram service, citing Section 3.3. However, Section 3.4 of the policy explicitly lists services that do not require prior authorization. This list includes 'diagnostic imaging of the breast.' A diagnostic mammogram falls under the category of diagnostic imaging of the breast. Therefore, the specific provision in Section 3.4 carves out this service from the general requirement in Section 3.3, meaning prior authorization was not required.

citations.quote:
The following services do not require prior authorization: emergency services, urgent care,
diagnostic imaging of the breast, routine prenatal care, and preventive services described in
Section 3.6.

sub_claims.text: Prior authorization was not obtained for the diagnostic mammogram service.
sub_claims.rationale: The insurer's sub-claim asserts that prior authorization was not obtained for a diagnostic mammogram. However, the policy explicitly lists 'diagnostic imaging of the breast' as a service that does not require prior authorization (Chunk p-3-4). Since a diagnostic mammogram falls under diagnostic imaging of the breast, the requirement to obtain prior authorization does not exist for this service. Therefore, the claim that authorization was missing is contradicted by the policy provision exempting such services from that requirement.
